## Per-element detail

### `PolarisAvatar` → `<s-avatar>`

Wraps `<s-avatar>`, a compact profile image or initials.

- Official name: Avatar
- Category: media-and-visuals
- Minimum supported version: 1.1
- Implementation status: wrapped
- Verification: browser-verified
- Docs: <https://shopify.dev/docs/api/app-home/latest/web-components/media-and-visuals/avatar>

| Parameter | C# type | Rendered as | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Initials` | `string?` | attribute | Up to two characters shown when there is no image. |
| `Src` | `string?` | attribute | Image URL. Falls back to `Initials` when it fails to load. |
| `Alt` | `string?` | attribute | Alternative description of the image. |
| `Size` | `PolarisSize` | attribute | Avatar size. Polaris documents this as the small through large steps. |
| `OnLoad` | `EventCallback<PolarisEventArgs>` | event callback | Raised when the image loads. |
| `OnError` | `EventCallback<PolarisEventArgs>` | event callback | Raised when the image fails to load. |

| Event | Callback | Documented | Wired |
|---|---|---|---|
| `error` | `OnError` | yes | yes |
| `load` | `OnLoad` | yes | yes |

No slots.

Accessibility requirements:

- alt carries the person's name; without it the avatar is announced as a decorative image and the name is lost.

Exercised by:

- `Avatar_forwards_load_and_error`
- `Avatar_renders_initials_and_size`

Notes: Cross-origin images need CORS headers. An unsupported format or a failed load falls back to initials. Initials longer than two characters may truncate. No slots, so an avatar cannot carry its own wrapper content.

### `PolarisBadge` → `<s-badge>`

Wraps `<s-badge>`.

- Official name: Badge
- Category: feedback-and-status-indicators
- Minimum supported version: 1.1
- Implementation status: wrapped
- Verification: browser-verified
- Docs: <https://shopify.dev/docs/api/app-home/latest/web-components/feedback-and-status-indicators/badge>

| Parameter | C# type | Rendered as | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Tone` | `PolarisTone` | attribute | Semantic colour. |
| `Color` | `PolarisColor` | attribute | Contrast of the badge. |
| `Size` | `PolarisSize` | attribute | Badge size. |
| `Icon` | `string?` | attribute | Name of a predefined admin icon shown before the label. |

No events.

| Slot | Accepts | Wrapper support | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `children` | HTMLElement | ChildContent | The badge label. Single line and truncated with an ellipsis, with no tooltip, so a long value is silently cut. |

Accessibility requirements:

- The badge is a status indicator, not an interactive control: put the meaning in text, because tone alone is not announced.
- tone must not be the only signal — critical and success read identically to a screen reader unless the label says so.

Exercised by:

- `Badge_renders_tone_colour_size_and_icon`

Notes: Single line, truncates with an ellipsis. Predefined admin icons only. Shopify's docs say to use s-chip instead when the content is a user-created label, category or tag rather than a status.

### `PolarisBanner` → `<s-banner>`

Wraps `<s-banner>`.

- Official name: Banner
- Category: feedback-and-status-indicators
- Minimum supported version: 1.1
- Implementation status: wrapped
- Verification: browser-verified
- Docs: <https://shopify.dev/docs/api/app-home/latest/web-components/feedback-and-status-indicators/banner>

| Parameter | C# type | Rendered as | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Heading` | `string?` | attribute | Banner title. |
| `Tone` | `PolarisTone` | attribute | Semantic colour. Use `PolarisTone.Critical` for failures. |
| `Hidden` | `bool` | attribute | Renders the banner hidden. Useful for toggling an inline error without re-rendering the surrounding page. |
| `Dismissible` | `bool` | attribute | Shows a close button. |
| `OnDismiss` | `EventCallback<PolarisEventArgs>` | event callback | Raised when the merchant dismisses the banner. |
| `OnAfterHide` | `EventCallback<PolarisEventArgs>` | event callback | Raised after the banner has finished hiding. |

| Event | Callback | Documented | Wired |
|---|---|---|---|
| `afterhide` | `OnAfterHide` | yes | yes |
| `dismiss` | `OnDismiss` | yes | yes |

| Slot | Accepts | Wrapper support | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `children` | HTMLElement | ChildContent | The banner body. |
| `secondary-actions` | s-button with variant="secondary" or "auto" | child Slot parameter | One or more secondary buttons. Polaris validates the children, so the slot attribute belongs on the button, not on a wrapping element. |

Accessibility requirements:

- A dismissible banner needs a heading or body text that says what is being dismissed; the close button is icon-only and its accessible name comes from Polaris.
- critical tone is a visual signal only — state the problem in the text as well.

Exercised by:

- `Banner_renders_hidden_only_when_asked`

Notes: Dismissal is not persisted: record it in the application, or the banner returns on the next render. No auto-queueing or prioritisation, and it cannot be made sticky or fixed. The wrapper makes `afterhide` explicit because the DOM name is not one of the modelled constants.

### `PolarisBox` → `<s-box>`

Wraps `<s-box>`, the generic styling container.

- Official name: Box
- Category: layout-and-structure
- Minimum supported version: 1.1
- Implementation status: wrapped
- Verification: browser-verified
- Docs: <https://shopify.dev/docs/api/app-home/latest/web-components/layout-and-structure/box>

| Parameter | C# type | Rendered as | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Background` | `string?` | attribute | Background treatment, for example subdued or transparent. |
| `Padding` | `string?` | attribute | Padding on all sides. |
| `PaddingBlock` | `string?` | attribute | Block-axis padding, overriding `Padding`. |
| `PaddingInline` | `string?` | attribute | Inline-axis padding, overriding `Padding`. |
| `Border` | `string?` | attribute | Border treatment, for example base. |
| `BorderStyle` | `string?` | attribute | Border style, for example dashed. |
| `BorderRadius` | `string?` | attribute | Border radius, for example base. |
| `Overflow` | `string?` | attribute | Overflow behaviour: visible or hidden. |
| `Display` | `string?` | attribute | Display: auto or none. |
| `BlockSize` | `string?` | attribute | Block size, including the responsive @container (...) form. |
| `InlineSize` | `string?` | attribute | Inline size. |
| `AccessibilityRole` | `string?` | attribute | ARIA role of the container. |

No events.

| Slot | Accepts | Wrapper support | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `children` | HTMLElement | ChildContent | Any content. |

Accessibility requirements:

- A generic container carries no semantics; set accessibilityRole when the box is a landmark such as main, navigation or aside.
- accessibilityLabel is only meaningful together with a role — a label on a generic box is ignored by assistive technology.

Exercised by:

- `Box_renders_the_styling_properties_it_models`

Notes: Box is the base for the shared styling prop set (padding, border, background, size, overflow, display) that s-clickable, s-grid, s-grid-item and s-stack inherit. Custom CSS is not supported anywhere in the library.

### `PolarisButton` → `<s-button>`

Wraps Shopify's `<s-button>`.

- Official name: Button
- Category: actions
- Minimum supported version: 1.1
- Implementation status: wrapped
- Verification: browser-verified
- Docs: <https://shopify.dev/docs/api/app-home/latest/web-components/actions/button>

| Parameter | C# type | Rendered as | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Variant` | `PolarisButtonVariant` | attribute | Emphasis of the button. |
| `Tone` | `PolarisTone` | attribute | Semantic colour, usually `PolarisTone.Critical` for a destructive action. |
| `Icon` | `string?` | attribute | Name of a predefined admin icon, rendered before the label. |
| `Disabled` | `bool` | attribute | Prevents interaction. A disabled button also leaves the tab order. |
| `Loading` | `bool` | attribute | Shows the button's own loading state. Polaris documents that this gives feedback but does <em>not debounce or block repeat clicks. Guard against double submission in C# as well. |
| `Type` | `PolarisButtonType` | attribute | Form behaviour: submit or reset the closest form. |
| `Href` | `string?` | attribute | Renders the button as a link. Shopify may block external URLs inside the Admin. |
| `Target` | `PolarisLinkTarget` | attribute | Browsing context for `Href`. |
| `InlineSize` | `PolarisButtonInlineSize` | attribute | Width behaviour of the button. |
| `CommandFor` | `string?` | attribute | Id of the element this button controls: the declarative way to open a modal or popover with no JavaScript at all. |
| `Command` | `PolarisCommand` | attribute | The command sent to `CommandFor`. |
| `InterestFor` | `string?` | attribute | Id of a tooltip or popover shown when the button is hovered or focused. |
| `OnClick` | `EventCallback<PolarisEventArgs>` | event callback | Raised on click. Modifier keys are on the event args. |
| `OnBlur` | `EventCallback<PolarisEventArgs>` | event callback | Raised when the button loses focus. |
| `OnFocus` | `EventCallback<PolarisEventArgs>` | event callback | Raised when the button receives focus. |

| Event | Callback | Documented | Wired |
|---|---|---|---|
| `blur` | `OnBlur` | yes | yes |
| `click` | `OnClick` | yes | yes |
| `focus` | `OnFocus` | yes | yes |

| Slot | Accepts | Wrapper support | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `children` | HTMLElement | ChildContent | The button label. |

Accessibility requirements:

- An icon-only button must set accessibilityLabel: the icon is not announced, so without it the control has no name.
- A disabled button leaves the tab order and cannot receive focus, so it needs visible text explaining why it is disabled.
- loading communicates that an action is in progress; prefer it to disabled for an async operation.

Exercised by:

- `Button_forwards_command_for_so_a_modal_opens_without_javascript`
- `Button_omits_a_false_boolean_entirely`
- `Button_registers_an_interop_listener_only_for_supplied_callbacks`
- `Button_renders_a_true_boolean_as_a_bare_attribute`
- `Button_renders_the_custom_element`
- `Button_renders_variant_and_tone_as_shopify_values`
- `Child_components_carry_their_slot_attribute`
- `Menu_renders_its_accessible_label_and_accepts_button_children`

Notes: loading gives feedback but does not debounce or block repeat clicks — guard double submission in C#. External href targets may be blocked by the Admin. Icon-only buttons have a fixed touch target and do not fill the available space.

### `PolarisButtonGroup` → `<s-button-group>`

Wraps `<s-button-group>`.

- Official name: Button group
- Category: actions
- Minimum supported version: 1.1
- Implementation status: wrapped
- Verification: browser-verified
- Docs: <https://shopify.dev/docs/api/app-home/latest/web-components/actions/button-group>

| Parameter | C# type | Rendered as | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Gap` | `PolarisButtonGroupGap` | attribute | Gap between the buttons. |

No events.

| Slot | Accepts | Wrapper support | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `children` | HTMLElement | ChildContent | Unslotted buttons. |
| `primary-action` | one s-button with variant="primary" | child Slot parameter | Exactly one button, and it cannot be used when gap="none". Polaris rejects a wrapping element. |
| `secondary-actions` | one or more s-button with variant="secondary" or "auto" | child Slot parameter | Supporting actions, with lower emphasis than the primary action. |

Accessibility requirements:

- accessibilityLabel is the only accessible name the group has, so set it when the surrounding heading does not already describe the actions.

Exercised by:

- `ButtonGroup_renders_its_gap`

Notes: The primary-action slot is incompatible with gap="none"; Polaris ignores the slot rather than failing loudly. Main actions belong in primary-action and supporting actions in secondary-actions to keep the hierarchy readable.

### `PolarisCheckbox` → `<s-checkbox>`

Wraps `<s-checkbox>`.

- Official name: Checkbox
- Category: forms
- Minimum supported version: 1.1
- Implementation status: wrapped
- Verification: browser-verified
- Docs: <https://shopify.dev/docs/api/app-home/latest/web-components/forms/checkbox>

| Parameter | C# type | Rendered as | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Label` | `string?` | attribute | Label shown beside the box. |
| `Details` | `string?` | attribute | Help text below the checkbox. |
| `Error` | `string?` | attribute | Validation message. |
| `Checked` | `bool` | dom property | Whether the box is ticked. Written as a DOM property after upgrade. Polaris does not reflect checked as an attribute, so a server-side change only takes effect through the property. |
| `DefaultChecked` | `bool?` | attribute | Initial checked state only. |
| `Indeterminate` | `bool` | dom property | Renders the mixed state used by a "select all" control. |
| `Value` | `string?` | attribute | Value submitted when the box is ticked. |
| `Name` | `string?` | attribute | Form field name. |
| `Required` | `bool` | attribute | Marks the checkbox as required. |
| `Disabled` | `bool` | attribute | Prevents interaction. |
| `LabelAccessibilityVisibility` | `PolarisAccessibilityVisibility?` | attribute | Hides the label visually while keeping it for screen readers. |
| `OnChange` | `EventCallback<PolarisEventArgs>` | event callback | Raised when the box is toggled. Read args.Checked. |
| `OnInput` | `EventCallback<PolarisEventArgs>` | event callback | Raised on every change to the box. |
| `OnBlur` | `EventCallback<PolarisEventArgs>` | event callback | Raised when the checkbox loses focus. |

| Event | Callback | Documented | Wired |
|---|---|---|---|
| `blur` | `OnBlur` | yes | yes |
| `change` | `OnChange` | yes | yes |
| `input` | `OnInput` | yes | yes |

No slots.

Accessibility requirements:

- label is the accessible name; without it the box is announced as an unlabelled checkbox.
- labelAccessibilityVisibility="exclusive" hides the label visually but keeps it for screen readers, which is the correct way to label a checkbox inside a table.

Exercised by:

- `Checkbox_keeps_checked_out_of_the_markup_because_it_is_not_reflected`

Notes: checked is not reflected: render it as a DOM property after upgrade, never as an attribute. indeterminate is a property for the same reason. Shopify's docs say to use s-switch instead when the setting applies immediately rather than being submitted with a form.

|---|---|---|---|
| `Color` | `PolarisColor` | attribute | Colour intensity. |

| `children` | HTMLElement | ChildContent | The chip label. Single line, truncated with an ellipsis. |

### `PolarisChoiceList` → `<s-choice-list>`

Wraps `<s-choice-list>`, for choosing one or many options.

- Official name: Choice list
- Category: forms
- Minimum supported version: 1.1
- Implementation status: wrapped
- Verification: browser-verified
- Docs: <https://shopify.dev/docs/api/app-home/latest/web-components/forms/choice-list>

| Parameter | C# type | Rendered as | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Label` | `string?` | attribute | Visible list label. |
| `Details` | `string?` | attribute | Help text below the list. |
| `Error` | `string?` | attribute | Validation message. |
| `Multiple` | `bool` | attribute | Allows more than one choice. Without it the list is a radio group. |
| `Values` | `IReadOnlyList<string>?` | dom property | The chosen values. Null or empty selects nothing. |
| `Disabled` | `bool` | attribute | Prevents interaction with the whole list. |
| `Name` | `string?` | attribute | Form field name. |
| `LabelAccessibilityVisibility` | `PolarisAccessibilityVisibility?` | attribute | Hides the label visually while keeping it for screen readers. |
| `OnChange` | `EventCallback<PolarisEventArgs>` | event callback | Raised when the selection is committed. args.Values holds the chosen values. |
| `OnInput` | `EventCallback<PolarisEventArgs>` | event callback | Raised on every change to the selection. |

| Event | Callback | Documented | Wired |
|---|---|---|---|
| `change` | `OnChange` | yes | yes |
| `input` | `OnInput` | yes | yes |

| Slot | Accepts | Wrapper support | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `children` | s-choice only | ChildContent | Anything other than an s-choice is rejected. |

Accessibility requirements:

- label is the accessible name of the whole group; without it the radio or checkbox group has none.
- labelAccessibilityVisibility="exclusive" keeps the label for screen readers while hiding it visually.

Exercised by:

- `ChoiceList_sets_values_as_a_property_because_no_attribute_can_carry_an_array`
- `ChoiceList_writes_an_empty_array_rather_than_leaving_values_undefined`

Notes: The only multi-select control, and `values` is an array so it must be a DOM property — an attribute would render the type name and select nothing. A stale array keeps options selected that the server has dropped, so ClearedProperties must clear it. No search, filter or lazy loading, and the whole list is either single or multiple, never a mix.

No events.

| Slot | Accepts | Wrapper support | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `children` | HTMLElement | ChildContent | The label is produced by concatenating the text nodes; markup inside is ignored. |
| `details` | HTMLElement | child Slot parameter | Supporting text shown with the label. |

Accessibility requirements:

Exercised by:

- `Choice_keeps_selected_out_of_the_markup_because_it_is_not_reflected`

Notes: Only valid inside s-choice-list. selected is not reflected, so it is set as a DOM property; the value reported up is the choice's `value`, or "on" when it is unset. The wrapper exposes details and secondary-content only through the child's own Slot parameter.

Accessibility requirements:

Exercised by:

- `Clickable_registers_only_the_callbacks_it_was_given`
- `Clickable_renders_box_styling_and_presence_booleans`

Notes: For custom interactive surfaces that Button or Link cannot express. It inherits the whole box styling set, so it is the one action component whose appearance is configurable. Polaris adds keyboard handling for the element itself, but the role is still the caller's responsibility.

| `graphic` | one s-image or s-icon, directly or as the only child of a wrapper | child Slot parameter | An icon must be size="base". |
| `subheading` | HTMLElement | child Slot parameter | Supporting text below the heading. |
| `primary-action` | exactly one s-button with variant="primary" | child Slot parameter | Anything else is ignored with a development warning. |
| `secondary-actions` | exactly one s-button with variant="secondary" or "auto" | child Slot parameter | One button despite the plural name. |

Accessibility requirements:

- heading is plain text and cannot contain markup, so it must read as a complete sentence for a screen reader.
- The action buttons carry the only interactive names; label them with verbs that match the guidance.

Exercised by:

- `EmptyState_accepts_its_subheading_slot`
- `EmptyState_puts_its_subheading_in_the_slot_rather_than_dropping_it`

Notes: Outside a table it does not detect emptiness, so render it conditionally. The action slots accept exactly one button each — a second button in primary-action is ignored silently. heading cannot contain markup.

### `PolarisHeading` → `<s-heading>`

Wraps `<s-heading>`.

- Official name: Heading
- Category: typography-and-content
- Minimum supported version: 1.1
- Implementation status: wrapped
- Verification: browser-verified
- Docs: <https://shopify.dev/docs/api/app-home/latest/web-components/typography-and-content/heading>

| Parameter | C# type | Rendered as | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `FontSize` | `PolarisFontSize` | attribute | Font size. |
| `LineClamp` | `int?` | attribute | Lines after which the heading is truncated visually. |
| `AccessibilityRole` | `string?` | attribute | Set to none to remove the heading semantics. |
| `AccessibilityVisibility` | `PolarisAccessibilityVisibility?` | attribute | How assistive technology sees the heading. |

No events.

| Slot | Accepts | Wrapper support | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `children` | HTMLElement | ChildContent | The heading text. |

Accessibility requirements:

- The heading level is derived from nesting depth and cannot be set, so the document outline depends on where the heading sits in the tree.
- accessibilityRole="none" strips the heading semantics while keeping the appearance — the correct choice for a visual label that is not a section heading.
- accessibilityVisibility="exclusive" keeps a heading available to screen readers while hiding it visually.

Exercised by:

- `Heading_renders_size_clamp_and_role`

Notes: You cannot choose h1/h2/h3; the level follows nesting depth and stops at h4. lineClamp truncates visually only — the full text is still read out.

| `Href` | `string?` | attribute | Destination URL. Without one the link renders as plain text. |

Exercised by:

- `AppNav_renders_its_links_and_passes_the_home_rel_through`
- `Link_omits_target_when_there_is_no_href`
- `Link_renders_href_tone_and_target`

Notes: No loading or disabled state, and a link must not be used as a button: Shopify's docs point to s-button for prominent actions and form submission. The Admin may override some navigation. download is unreliable cross-origin.

| `focus` | `OnFocus` | yes | yes |

No slots.

Accessibility requirements:

- label is the accessible name; the prefix and suffix are decorative and are not announced, so the label must carry the unit.

Exercised by:

- `Every_new_field_writes_its_value_as_a_dom_property`
- `NumberField_renders_step_bounds_affixes_and_input_mode`

Notes: value is a string, not a number. step, min and max are numbers and are rendered with invariant formatting. prefix and suffix are not part of the submitted value. inputMode does not block non-numeric input.

| `Loading` | `bool` | attribute | Shows the table's own loading state. loading is a reflected boolean, so clearing it needs both the property and the attribute cleared; the interop layer does both. Reserve this for the table itself rather than stacking a spinner on top of it. |
| `Variant` | `string?` | attribute | list renders stacked key and value pairs; auto is the default. |
| `Paginate` | `bool` | attribute | Renders previous and next controls driven by the page events. |
| `HasNextPage` | `bool` | attribute | Whether a next page exists. Only meaningful with `Paginate`. |
| `HasPreviousPage` | `bool` | attribute | Whether a previous page exists. Only meaningful with `Paginate`. |
| `Filters` | `RenderFragment?` | render flag | Filters rendered in the table's header area. |
| `ChildContent` | `RenderFragment?` | render flag | The header row and body. |
| `OnNextPage` | `EventCallback<PolarisEventArgs>` | event callback | Raised when the merchant asks for the next page. |
| `OnPreviousPage` | `EventCallback<PolarisEventArgs>` | event callback | Raised when the merchant asks for the previous page. |

| Event | Callback | Documented | Wired |
|---|---|---|---|
| `nextpage` | `OnNextPage` | yes | yes |
| `previouspage` | `OnPreviousPage` | yes | yes |

| Slot | Accepts | Wrapper support | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `children` | s-table-header-row and s-table-body | none | The header row must come before the body. |
| `filters` | HTMLElement | child Slot parameter | Content rendered in the table's filter area, typically search and choice controls. |

Accessibility requirements:

- The number of cells in a row should match the number of headers, or the column association is wrong for screen readers.
- clickDelegate is a click-only affordance and adds no keyboard or screen-reader behaviour; the row must still contain an interactive element such as s-link that keyboard users can reach.

Exercised by:

- `Table_loading_is_a_reflected_boolean`

Notes: Composed: the header row, body, row and cell are separate elements. No built-in sorting or search and no sticky headers. variant="list" renders stacked key-value pairs and is the default on mobile, which is what listSlot on the header controls. Shopify recommends wrapping it in s-section padding="none".

### `PolarisAppNav` → `<s-app-nav>`

Wraps `<s-app-nav>`: the navigation menu for your app inside the Shopify admin.

- Official name: App nav
- Category: app-bridge
- Minimum supported version: app-bridge
- Implementation status: wrapped
- Verification: unit-tested
- Docs: <https://shopify.dev/docs/api/app-home/latest/app-bridge-web-components/app-nav>

No parameters of its own.

No events.

| Slot | Accepts | Wrapper support | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `children` | s-link | ChildContent | One link per navigation item. href must be a relative path inside the app. Exactly one link may carry rel="home", which designates the landing route and is HIDDEN from the rendered menu. |

Accessibility requirements:

- Labels should be one or two nouns naming the destination ("Products", "Settings"), not verbs such as "Manage" — this matches how the rest of the admin reads.
- Order the items by importance: the most frequently used section first.

Exercised by:

- `AppNav_renders_its_links_and_passes_the_home_rel_through`

Notes: An App Bridge component, delivered by app-bridge.js rather than polaris-1.js and therefore NOT versioned with Polaris. It configures the admin's own navigation for the app — the left sidebar on desktop, a dropdown from the title bar on mobile — so it draws nothing inside the app's own frame, and nothing at all outside the admin. Exactly one per document, and it must be in the body. Navigation cannot be nested: one level only, so a submenu silently does nothing. The app name in the sidebar already links to the home route, so rel="home" is only needed when the home page is not at "/". Not browser-probed, and that is a measured fact rather than an omission: the sample gallery was opened in a real headless Chrome and app-bridge.js does NOT define this element outside the Shopify Admin, so the probe reports it as undefined. It is only defined once App Bridge has connected to the admin host.

| `OnHide` | `EventCallback<PolarisEventArgs>` | event callback | Raised when the window closes. |

| Event | Callback | Documented | Wired |

Accessibility requirements:

Exercised by:

- `AppWindow_renders_its_src_and_calls_the_elements_own_methods`

Notes: An App Bridge component, delivered by app-bridge.js rather than polaris-1.js and therefore NOT versioned with Polaris. It loads src in an iframe that covers the screen, with a top bar the admin controls so the merchant can always leave. Drive it declaratively (a button with command="--show|--hide|--toggle" and commandFor="<id>") or with its show()/hide()/toggle() methods. Prefer s-modal for an ordinary dialog: it decides for itself whether to render inside the app or as a fullscreen overlay. A form inside the window takes data-save-bar on the FORM — a save bar on the parent page renders behind the window and cannot be clicked. Not browser-probed, and that is a measured fact rather than an omission: the sample gallery was opened in a real headless Chrome and app-bridge.js does NOT define this element outside the Shopify Admin, so the probe reports it as undefined. It is only defined once App Bridge has connected to the admin host.
